description: Upload a model (STEP, STL, OBJ, 3MF, or native CAD) or a PDF print from this computer, to quote it, split it into its parts or send it to a shop. path is the file's path ('~/Desktop/Bracket.step'); name, if given, is what to call it (default: the file's own name). From SolidWorks or any CAD tool: save or export STEP, then upload that path. Returns its file id. Needs an API key.

name.description: What to call it (default: the file's own name).

path.description: The file's path on this computer.

name: upload_file
